kdomshrine.name: Cologne Cathedral
kdomshrine.slogan: Two spires, 632 years in the making, and the Three Kings inside.
kdomshrine.line: Begun in 1248 and finished in 1880, it was the tallest building in the world until 1884.

khohenzollern.name: Hohenzollern Bridge
khohenzollern.slogan: Half a million padlocks and a train every minute or so.
khohenzollern.line: The River Rhine, it is well known, / Doth wash your city of Cologne; / But tell me, Nymphs, what power divine / Shall henceforth wash the river Rhine?

kcaugustusburg.name: Augustusburg Palace
kcaugustusburg.slogan: A rococo staircase of marble, jasper and stucco in Brühl.
kcaugustusburg.line: Until 1994, Germany's president hosted visiting heads of state here, because the palace stood near the then capital, Bonn.

kcaltenberg.name: Altenberg Cathedral
kcaltenberg.slogan: A Cistercian church in the Dhünn valley, shared by two faiths.
kcaltenberg.line: Founded by Cistercians in 1133, it was rebuilt after a fire in 1815 and made open to both Catholics and Protestants.

kmoschee.name: Cologne Central Mosque
kmoschee.slogan: A glass-and-concrete dome by the Böhms in Ehrenfeld.
kmoschee.line: Its two minarets stand 55 metres tall, and the hall holds up to 4,000 worshippers.
